description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data entries across different task categories in the 1.4 million open-source distilled reasoning dataset, with seven distinct slices representing the proportions of each category. The largest segment is Math, shown in red and accounting for 29.3% of the total, followed by Coding in blue at 24.3%, and Information Seeking in green at 22.2%. The fourth largest segment is Reasoning, depicted in orange at 10.4%. The remaining categories are smaller: Planning (purple, 2.3%), Creative Writing (pink, 2.2%), and Others (combined, light green, 9.3%). The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps each color to its category and corresponding count, and percentage labels are also displayed directly on or near each slice for clarity. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting with Math at the top left and proceeding clockwise.
